candidate_decisions.reason: Stable release materially expands hardware, memory and MoE serving paths.

candidate_decisions.title: Ollama 0.40.14
candidate_decisions.reason: Stable release changes sampler-default behavior and fixes Responses and coding-agent launch paths.

candidate_decisions.title: WebHarbor
candidate_decisions.reason: Public code, images, tasks and checkpoint create a practical browser-agent evaluation environment.

candidate_decisions.title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks
candidate_decisions.reason: The study measures live tool execution and confirmed secret exfiltration across frameworks; code availability remains unresolved.

candidate_decisions.reason: Public Apache-2.0 components connect workload diagnosis and Slurm recovery with a monitor-first path.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI security sprint and higher bug bounties
candidate_decisions.reason: Security incentives and an internal sprint are relevant signals but do not add a distinct public technical artifact.

candidate_decisions.reason: Useful integration guidance, but not a release or independently measured engineering change.
